To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the films containing LAE are able to inhibit the growth of the microorganisms present in the food products studied, showing a significant effect against L. Monocytogenes and a moderate effect against E. coli.

the antimicrobial effect on L. monocytogens and E. coli of ethyl-N-a-dodecanoy1-1-arginate hydrochioride (LAE), incorporated into ethylene vinyle alcohol copolymere (EVOH), is effective for 10 days under refrigeration.
the antimicrobial effect is a function of both the concentration of the active compound and the film-forming solution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new active food packaging systems based on EVOH films containing the antimicrobial compound LAE.
developing a new packaging material that could be applied to extend the shelf-life of food products, while maintaining the quality of these products.
the antimicrobial effectiveness of ethyl-Nα-dodecanolyl-l-arginate (LAE) in EVOH films to extend the shelf-life of chicken stock and ready-made surimi sticks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the antimicrobial activity was demonstrated in vitro as well as in vivo, with the films being able to inhibit the food microbiota for 10  days under storage at 5 °C, showing an important antibacterial effect against both L. monocytogene and E. coli.
the films were able to maintain their antimicrobial activity for 10 day under storage at 5 °C, showing great potential as systems of sustained release of active compounds.
the films developed in the present work have shown a significant effect on the inhibition of L. monocytogens and E. coli in chicken stock and ready to eat surimi sticks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antimicrobial effect is due to the interaction between the LAE molecules and the bacterial cell membrane.
the use of antimicrobial packaging is an effective strategy to extend the shelf-life of food products, which is a great advantage for the food industry and consumers.
the use of LAE incorporated into EVOH film is a suitable alternative to preserve food products.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the antimicrobial effect is dependent on the type of food product and its microbiota, the concentration of active molecules, the film composition, the food product packaging conditions and the storage conditions of the food products.
the antimicrobial activity and the antimicrobial effectiveness of the LAE-EVOH films were highly dependent on the food product and on the food packaging conditions.
the antimicrobial effect is dependent on the food product and the concentration of the active compound.
